head_sha_semantics: payload_commit: the commit that carries the RTL, testbench, checker, vectors generator and evidence. The commit containing this JSON is the delivery commit D; D's own full SHA and its two-path remote read-back are stated in reports/agent_handoffs/DATA-7A.md section 9 and in the agent's final receipt.
known_limitations: The full VCD traces stay local (16 MB to 38 MB each, .vcd is not whitelisted); only their sha256 and the small derived tables are committed, so a reviewer re-runs the sources instead of replaying a dump.
The tick clock-enable is supplied by the testbench reference domain; its divider, the TCON 976/977 column schedule and the 50 MHz DCLK-to-PWM crossing are NOT_IMPLEMENTED here.

Asynchronous shut-off is proven as zero-delay logic priority only: MOS propagation, metastability, safe reset release and real device glitches are unmeasured, and the two-reference-cycle minimum width for blank/fault is a POC assumption, not a chip input specification.
pam_sel is a code. In Pure mode it is the symbol value 7, which is not 15 uA; the eight current levels, trimming and reference relationship remain NOT DEFINED.
Nothing is connected to the frozen Data-6 netlist; whether a grey-scale top reuses that analogue core or needs a timed latch interface is a later, separately reviewed MOS decision.
Optical effective grey bits, LED I-V, array RC, final VLED/VSCAN and SOA are NOT_VERIFIED; an RTL pass proves none of them.

One pre-existing unreachable large blob <blob:955497fb18ac>, 3,583,407 bytes, dated 2026-10-14 and not created by this round, makes --mode objects FAIL. It is left untouched: no GC, no history rewrite, no content printed.
This validator and this JSON prove field structure only; they do not verify remote truth, circuit behaviour or that any number is physically correct.
push_status_scope: read-back of the payload commit above, obtained before these bytes were written; never a claim about the commit that stores this file

remote_readback.transport_used_for_push: proxy (WinINET 127.0.0.1:7892), chosen after measuring both paths

scope_status_meaning: the DATA-7A digital-logic stage only. COMPLETE does not mean the PWM MOS circuit, the eight PAM current levels, the LUT, the array or the optics are done or verified.
